sources.title: GitHub - MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3
sources.snippet: MiniMax Music 3 is a high-performance music generation model for creating complete songs up to five minutes long. Conditioned on lyrics and a detailed music description, it generates structurally coherent songs with expressive vocals, evolving arrangements, and stable long-form audio quality ...

sources.title: Prompting MiniMax Music 3 - a Hugging Face Space by multimodalart
sources.snippet: The requested duration is an upper bound — the model ends the song naturally with a stop token when the lyrics run out. Short lyrics make short songs; a full five-minute song wants a full song's worth of sections.
